articles.summary: During National Homeownership Month, Tri Pointe Homes Nevada is celebrating the homeowners whose unique journeys reflect the true meaning of home. From blended families embracing fresh starts at Carlisle Ridge, to longtime Summerlin residents finally finding their dream home at Carlisle Peak, to educators discovering the perfect fit at Edgewood, and a Chicago transplant building a new life at Alpine Ridge, each story highlights how a Tri Pointe home has become the foundation for new memories and future dreams. While every homeowner's experience is different, they all share an appreciation for thoughtfully designed homes, exceptional customer care, and a supportive team that made the homebuying process seamless. Together, their stories demonstrate that homeownership is about much more than a house—it's about finding a place to belong, grow, and create lasting memories.
